reason: Cold leads on Thumbtack cost me real money, so the problem is real. But nobody outside the owner's own company pays for this yet, and I run everything on Excel, my phone and WhatsApp. I'm not handing my leads and my techs' schedule to an unproven tool.
objection: There are no reviews and no case studies from other companies like mine. I'd be the guinea pig, and if it messes up an answer to a lead I've already paid for, I lose the job and the money.
would_change_my_mind: Two or three real home-service companies my size, with names I can call, saying it got them back leads that would have gone cold. Or a trial where it answers my Thumbtack leads next to me, so I can watch it before I trust it.
